hierarchy_composition.evidence: desktop_fold squint: three staggered mosaic panes (tanks; yard with drums and a worker; RKSPL tanker) dominate the right. Headline Entrust your supply to Gundlav is second. Filled Request a quote is third. Hero is left-aligned on mist. Mosaic col2 is now the yard. Quality page proof sequence (lab photo, then LABSA in a beaker) is specific.

reference_fidelity.evidence: No compare.png. Judged from refs/vico-footer.png vs footer_crop.png, and inner photo pageheads vs a flat navy slab. Footer takes the idea: navy void, original shed/tanks/tanker/drums, no cranes, no Vico green. Skyline is mid-navy on #011637 so on squint it is quieter than the reference. Inner pageheads show the tanker through a navy wash instead of a solid slab.
strengths: Footer uses original tank, tanker and drum skyline on a dark band; navy not Vico green.
Inner pageheads are photo-backed rather than a flat navy slab.
Pages still use this plant's photos, tables and place names.

issues.problem: RK tanks/tanker/drums are a close navy on #011637, so the signature strip almost disappears on squint.
issues.fix: Recolor the silhouette fill to about #4a6a88 with #012056 inner cuts. Vary shed vs tank vs drum heights by at least 40px. Do not add cranes or import Vico green.

issues.fix: Use a left-to-right overlay rgba(1,22,55,0.82) at the title to rgba(1,32,86,0.58) over the tanker.
